gotchas: **Pickup bypass** — append `?pickup=true` to the store URL. No delivery address needed, the post-add-to-cart address dialog never appears, and `CheckoutButton` carries its own lat/lng.

**Delivery-mode address gate is unfillable** — `#HomeAddressAutocomplete` (storefront) and `[data-testid="AddressAutocompleteField"]` (post-add-to-cart dialog) are controlled React comboboxes over a places-autocomplete. A programmatic fill is cleared by the page's re-render: field reads empty, no suggestion list. Signing in does not help when the account has no stored address. Use pickup instead.

**Turnstile fires every new session** — Cloudflare interstitial on first load, full block, zero page content. Clears only via challenge handoff to the account owner. Store URLs load clean afterwards for that session.
**Login has two layouts** — submit is `#login-submit-button` (`IdentityLoginSigninButton`) OR `#guided-submit-button` (`IdentityGuidedSubmitButton`). Probe for both.
**Login fields** — `[data-anchor-id="IdentityLoginPageEmailField"]` + `[data-anchor-id="IdentityLoginPagePasswordField"]`, same step. Enter does NOT submit. No MFA presented.
**Storefront Sign In is not clickable** — hit test times out. Go to `identity.doordash.com/auth` directly.
**Checkout stepper step 1 does not expand on click** — `[data-testid="Checkout-vertical-stepper-ACCOUNT_DETAILS-label"]`. Sign in first, then return to checkout.
**Menu items have no stable selector** — match the price text, then take the nearest ancestor carrying `@data-item-id` / `@data-anchor-id` / `@role=button`.
**Proxy instability** — connection dropped 3x in one run. Each drop loses cart, login and Turnstile clearance. Budget for restarting from the store URL.

Observed 2026-10-06 (proxy, US tunnel): account signup is the "Sign Up" header link, which opens a dialog with an iframe (first/last name, email, mobile number with a Country Code picker defaulting to +1, password of 10+ characters, #sign-up-submit-button). Submitting sends a one-time code by TEXT to that mobile number (input[autocomplete=one-time-code]); no email alternative was found. Set the country picker to the phone's own country before filling the number — a non-US national number under the +1 default goes to an unrelated US number. With +91 (India) selected no SMS arrived, so an account needs a phone DoorDash will text (likely US).

## Verified path (pickup)

1. Open `https://www.doordash.com/store/<slug>/?pickup=true`
2. Clear Turnstile via challenge handoff
3. Click item: price text → nearest ancestor with `@data-item-id` / `@data-anchor-id` / `@role=button`
4. Add: `[data-anchor-id="AddToCartButtonSeoOptimization"]`
5. Cart: `[data-anchor-id="HeaderOrderCart"]`
6. Checkout: `[data-anchor-id="CheckoutButton"]` → `/consumer/checkout/?lat=..&lng=..&order_cart_id=..`
7. Sign in at `identity.doordash.com/auth`, return to checkout
8. Final CTA: `[data-anchor-id="PlaceOrderButton"]` — disabled until account + payment steps complete
